patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Grafana Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than Grafana Cloud's shape. Choose Grafana Cloud only if your buying job matches “Managed Grafana observability — Free 10k series / 50 GB logs; Pro from $19/mo platform fee” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage differs because AppDynamics is shaped for Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium ( whereas Grafana Cloud is shaped for Managed Grafana observability — Free 10k series / 50 GB logs; Pro from. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Grafana Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; Grafana Cloud is Managed Grafana observability — Free 10k series / 50 GB logs; Pro from $19/mo platform fee + usage ($6.50/1k series, $8/user)..
- Company-size focus: AppDynamics (mid-market, enterprise) vs Grafana Cloud (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: AppDynamics — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Grafana Cloud — Pro bills many usage dimensions — the $19 fee is not the bill.

Limitations — AppDynamics: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); $6/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium $33 is; Grafana Cloud: Pro bills many usage dimensions — the $19 fee is not the bill; Free retention is 14 days — production teams usually need Pro.

Poor-fit cases: AppDynamics is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Grafana Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro bills many usage dimensions — the $19 fee is not the bill · Avoid AppDynamics if you actually need Grafana Cloud's motion (Managed Grafana observability — Free 10k series / 50 GB logs; Pro from $19/mo pl)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
